visual: Architectural evergreen with long, narrow, sword-shaped leaves in rich burgundy-red to deep bronze-purple. Forms a fountain-like rosette, eventually developing a woody trunk.
water: Water regularly while establishing and during prolonged dry spells.
soilWarning: No heavy, wet soil or winter waterlogging
prune: Minimal pruning required. Remove dead or damaged lower leaves as needed. Remove frost-damaged growth in spring once new shoots appear.
toxicity: Potentially toxic to cats and dogs if ingested, causing digestive upset. Avoid allowing pets to chew foliage.
hardinessNote: H3 · −5 to 1°C; hardy outdoors in mild coastal and sheltered UK gardens. Protect from prolonged frost and cold winter winds. Young and container-grown plants are particularly vulnerable.
resilience: Moderately drought tolerant once established, with good wind and coastal tolerance in mild climates. Vulnerable to prolonged hard frost and winter wet.
uses: architectural focal point · tropical-style borders · coastal gardens · Mediterranean planting · patio containers · contemporary landscapes
